acceptance: `--platform-option database_name=<name>` on SQLite creates and uses the named database file
Default naming unchanged when the option is absent
Test that fails without the fix
description: The SQLite config builder (benchbox/cli/platform_defaults.py:276-299) puts `<database_name>.db` into `connection_string`, but `get_platform_config` (benchbox/core/platform_config.py:56-57) drops that field, and `SQLiteAdapter.from_config` (benchbox/platforms/sqlite.py:233-249) falls back to `<runs_root>/databases/<bench_sf>/<bench_sf>_notuning_noconstraints.sqlite`. Confirmed: `--platform-option database_name=pytest_xyz` created the default-named file and no pytest_xyz.db.
